segments.summary: Reviewed integration, gate, state, cleanup, UI, blocked-outcome, and recovery canon; found an unbound authority seam in environment-based operation classification.
Reviewed blocked/restore consolidation plus document, DRY, rewrite-ownership, adjacent-input, and portability units; found a canonical payload field-token conflict.
Reviewed command routing, projection trust, blocked authority, reconciliation, transport, and guardrail ownership; projection freshness and denial behavior remain underspecified.
Reviewed core and compiled-context guards, defense layers, GUI effective state, runtime identity, lane enforcement, and multi-node scope; found critical credential-lifecycle and scope-identity gaps.

Reviewed overrides, pre-spawn hook, initialization, request binding, fail-closed behavior, module layout, and pattern resolution; override authority, request isolation, and module ownership need closure.
Reviewed guard state, baseline lookup, deliberate disable, command evaluation, normalization, and regex parsing; approval lifecycle and shell-aware identity are the main adversarial gaps.
Reviewed pattern merge, config labels/defaults/bridge/YAML, runner attachment, and retired fallback behavior; custom-pattern failure policy and effective-config correlation are unresolved.

Reviewed final command logging, prompt and context exceptions, double-check ordering, canonical paths, symlink scope, and provider coverage; privileged exceptions, new-file validation, and provider conformance need stronger contracts.
